chunks: Abu Basir asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Can a man shake hands with a woman who is not related to him by mahram?
He عليه السلام said: "No, except from behind a cloth."

key_terms.بِذِي مَحْرَمٍ: with mahram relation; a person within unmarriageable kinship
key_terms.مِنْ وَرَاءِ الثَّوْبِ: from behind a cloth; with a fabric barrier

ai.seo_question: Can a man shake hands with a non-mahram woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning physical contact between a man and a woman who are not mahram to one another. The Imam عليه السلام prohibits direct handshaking, while allowing it only with a barrier such as a cloth.
